goal: Allow outbound peers' initial address self-announcements to relay immediately
Clean up dead gating logic that no longer reliably suppresses address responses
reviewability: Reviews may wait a long time for an author response
agreement: Support for removing broken gatekeeping logic that no longer behaves as intended (stratospher, mzumsande)
Verified by testing that the flag no longer tracks address response state cleanly (danielabrozzoni)
Unaddressed objection: malicious outbound peers could abuse token allowances to relay spam (taki-abedesselam)
Nonblocking objection: relaying initial announcements could leak network topology and privacy (Crypt-iQ)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is an internal consistency cleanup of gating logic rendered ineffective by past changes
The change has minor relay behavioral impact and is not expected to affect node operators noticeably
